_about: Paul Myron Anthony Linebarger, American author, for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 by the non-renewal sweep, batch 8 (Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): the Gutenberg texts of Paul Myron Anthony Linebarger's 1931-1963 books that were never renewed, each checked in NYPL's cce-renewals. No uids minted. Linebarger also wrote science fiction as Cordwainer Smith; only his non-fiction under his own name is here.
